lines.text: This punch will never touch you.
Gojo's Infinity puts endless space between you and the fist.
To reach you, it crosses half the distance. Then half of what's left. Then half again.
A Greek thinker named Zeno came up with this over two thousand years ago.
Coins, bullets, even atoms slow down forever.
Time keeps going. Things just never get closer.
Running that math nonstop would fry a normal brain.
That's why Gojo needs the Six Eyes.
Push the Infinity inward and you get Blue. It pulls everything in.
Reverse it and you get Red. It blasts everything away.
Crash them together, and Hollow Purple erases whatever it touches.
Inside his domain, you get infinite information, and you can't move.
But there's a way around it.
Toji's Inverted Spear cancels the technique on contact.
And Sukuna stopped aiming at Gojo. He cut the space itself.
So the punch never lands, unless someone cuts the world in half.
